name: Aurora (United States)
description: Navy field charged at the centre with the city seal in yellow, a rising sun over the words AURORA.
history: Aurora is a home rule city located in Arapahoe, Adams, and Douglas counties, Colorado. The flag was adopted in 1969 (according to Flags of the World, which notes its official status is uncertain).

features.role: city seal in yellow, a rising sun over the words AURORA
